parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(
    json_agg(
        json_build_object(
            'direction', direction,
            'sender_type', sender_type,
            'text_body', text_body,
            'created_at', created_at
        )
        ORDER BY created_at ASC
    ),
    '[]'::json
) AS messages
FROM (
    SELECT direction, sender_type, text_body, created_at
    FROM messages m
    WHERE m.conversation_id = $1::uuid
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversations c WHERE c.id = m.conversation_id AND c.business_id = $2::uuid)
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 10
) recent;

parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(
  json_agg(
    json_build_object(
      'fact_key', cf.fact_key,
      'fact_value', cf.fact_value,
      'confidence', cf.confidence
    )
    ORDER BY cf.confidence DESC, cf.updated_at DESC
  ),
  '[]'::json
) AS facts
FROM customer_facts cf
WHERE cf.contact_id = $1::uuid
  AND (cf.business_id = $2::uuid OR cf.business_id IS NULL OR $2 = '');

SELECT COALESCE(summary, '') AS summary, COALESCE(message_count, 0) AS message_count, COALESCE(created_by, 'none') AS created_by
FROM conversation_summaries
WHERE conversation_id = $1::uuid
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COALESCE(
  json_agg(
    json_build_object(
      'id', id,
      'sku', sku,
      'name', name,
      'description', description,
      'price', price,
      'currency', currency,
      'unit', unit,
      'category', category,
      'product_type', product_type
    )
    ORDER BY name
  ),
  '[]'::json
) AS products
FROM products 
WHERE active = true AND business_id = $1::uuid
LIMIT 50;
